Name: Seeded Harbour-level fixture and pump-command check
Description: A deterministic fixture seeds PRT-WLV-01 from 40 cm to 110 cm. This is not a rain-driven or CityCore basin simulation and is not authentic field telemetry.
Expected: Twin: At tick 1, SensorBank samples the scenario-seeded 110.0 cm input for PRT-WLV-01. The fixture does not apply rain or mutate CityCore B-01. A separate local test-client command can change P-03 state; no Harbour response is implied.
Expected: Guardian: No external Guardian service is connected or invoked by this fixture scenario.
Expected: Brain: No external Brain service is connected or invoked. Tests may issue a local Brain-role pump command to verify command handling, not an autonomous incident response.
How to verify: Run python scenarios/run.py --scenario scn-02 and inspect the scenario-seeded sensor event. For physical water behavior, inspect CityCore state separately; this fixture does not represent a physical flash flood.
